name: Enhanced Sphere Tracing
definition: A sphere tracing variant that uses an over-relaxation factor (omega > 1) to accelerate convergence through conservative distance fields, mitigating issues where non-uniform scaling causes valid geometry to vanish due to fixed step budgets.
summary: Enhanced Sphere Tracing accelerates ray-marching convergence toward implicit surfaces by taking larger steps than standard sphere tracing, either through over-relaxation or geometric prediction.
